title: Darth Vader
description: Once a Jedi general and hero of the Clone Wars, the Sith formerly known as Anakin Skywalker fell to the dark side. Renamed Darth Vader, he earned his title as a Sith Lord by betraying the Jedi and joining Chancellor Palpatine in his bid to transform the Republic into his new Empire. As the Empire tightened its control across the galaxy and the Rebellion against it grew more unruly, Vader took it upon himself to bring further order to the galaxy. He confronted his former Padawan in the Sith Temple of Malachor where she almost bested him.
